```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

seurat_path = "/fh/fast/sun_w/yub/data/msk_30ko/raw/all.seu.merged.integrated.rds"
meta_path = "/fh/fast/sun_w/yub/data/msk_30ko/raw/df.meta.rds"
```

## Inputs

This report inspects the MSK reference Seurat object and metadata used for DRACC label transfer.

```{r load-data}
obj = readRDS(seurat_path)
meta = as.data.frame(readRDS(meta_path), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("cellid", "subcelltype") %in% names(meta)))

kable(data.frame(
  object_cells = ncol(obj),
  object_features = nrow(obj),
  metadata_rows = nrow(meta),
  metadata_columns = ncol(meta)
))
```

## Metadata Summary

The key metadata fields are summarized in the report without writing a separate output file.

```{r metadata-summary}
# Keep the original report's exact fields and fail if the metadata schema changes.
metadata_cols = c(
  "cellid", "subcelltype", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent_mito",
  "percent_ribo", "nCount_decontXcounts", "nFeature_decontXcounts",
  "QC1_nCount_RNA", "QC2_Doublets", "QC3_nFeature_RNA", "QC4_mito",
  "celltype_20250623", "stage"
)
stopifnot(all(metadata_cols %in% names(meta)))

metadata_summary = do.call(rbind, lapply(metadata_cols, \(column) {
  x = meta[[column]]
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(data.frame(
      column = column,
      n_missing = sum(is.na(x)),
      n_unique = length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])),
      min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      top_value = NA_character_,
      top_n = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  counts = sort(table(x, useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    column = column,
    n_missing = sum(is.na(x)),
    n_unique = length(counts),
    min = NA_real_,
    median = NA_real_,
    max = NA_real_,
    top_value = if (length(counts)) names(counts)[[1]] else NA_character_,
    top_n = if (length(counts)) as.integer(counts[[1]]) else NA_integer_
  )
}))
row.names(metadata_summary) = NULL

kable(metadata_summary)
```

## Subcelltype UMAP

```{r subcelltype-umap, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
cell_idx = match(colnames(obj), meta$cellid)
if (anyNA(cell_idx)) {
  stop("MSK metadata is missing ", sum(is.na(cell_idx)), " Seurat object cells.")
}
obj$subcelltype = meta$subcelltype[cell_idx]

reduction_candidates = c("umap.integrated", "umap.unintegrated", "umap", "integrated.umap", "wnn.umap")
reduction_name = reduction_candidates[reduction_candidates %in% Reductions(obj)][1]
if (is.na(reduction_name)) {
  stop("No UMAP reduction found. Available reductions: ", paste(Reductions(obj), collapse = ", "))
}

umap = as.data.frame(Embeddings(obj, reduction = reduction_name)[, 1:2])
names(umap) = c("umap_1", "umap_2")
umap$subcelltype = factor(obj$subcelltype)

subcelltype_levels = levels(umap$subcelltype)
subcelltype_cols = hcl.colors(length(subcelltype_levels), palette = "Dark 3")
names(subcelltype_cols) = subcelltype_levels

umap_plot = ggplot(umap, aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = subcelltype)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.22, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = subcelltype_cols) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

umap_plot
```
